items.title: European big pharma unites amid ‘ringing alarm bells’ of continent’s dominance
items.summary: All the chairs of Europe’s big pharma companies have written a public letter asserting that a shift in strategy is needed to close the gap to international rivals.

items.title: How China’s rise as a biopharma innovation hub is reshaping global dealmaking strategies
items.summary: GlobalData briefing: China biopharma drives global licensing growth, platform acquisitions, amid tightening US scrutiny.

items.title: BoomRay and Novartis sign $900m deal for radioligand therapy
items.summary: BoomRay Pharmaceuticals and Novartis have signed an exclusive worldwide licence deal for an undisclosed preclinical RLT asset in a deal worth up to $900m.

items.title: Boehringer and Envisagenics to develop precision cancer therapies in $1bn deal
items.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim and Envisagenics have entered into a research collaboration and option agreement aimed at validating tumour-specific targets for the development of precision therapies in solid tumours.
